standard.summary: 把两个 LoRA 重建到 dense delta 后按比例融合
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Rebuilds two LoRAs into dense deltas and blends them by ratio
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 把两个 LoRA 重建到 dense delta 后按比例融合，再 SVD 回目标 rank。

advanced_en.principle: Reconstructs two LoRAs into dense deltas, blends them by ratio, then SVD-decomposes back to the target rank.
